resume_brief: Build ranked candidate lists for three Forge3D catalog sections (rigging/animation, multiview/scan/reconstruction, CC0 asset libraries). Research-only: search web + upstream repos (github.com) for each candidate's license, terms, free-tier status; verify licenses from source (LICENSE files, terms pages); set license_verified true/false. Do NOT wire anything. Output JSON array to ~/workspace/forge3d/docs/catalog-parts/rigscan_assets.json with entries {name, url, what, license, license_verified, free_tier, impact (1-5), difficulty (1-5), notes}. No fake entries; UNVERIFIED if unconfirmable. Skip already-covered: Mixamo-map retarget, instance-rig, Bannon motion clips, GNM head, COLMAP/pycolmap, Poly Haven, ambientCG, Quaternius, Kenney, KayKit, cgbookcase, TextureCan, NASA 3D, Poly Pizza, Khronos glTF-Sample-Models, Smithsonian 3D. Report counts per section + top 8 picks with rationale.
